newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures turn higher in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures turn higher in choppy trade.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. debt futures edged up slightly in choppy trade, driven by short-term technicals. Traders said early support held, losses were minor and once futures began drifting up, buyers piled on. One notes trader said small buy-stops triggered above Wednesday's settlement prices. All eyes on 0900 CDT/1400 GMT NAPM, forecast at 53.6 from 55.0.
